links.outcome: Recognition of critical red flags such as ischemia requiring urgent vascular assessment
links.effect: Both LLMs demonstrated high proficiency in recognizing critical red flags such as signs of ischemia requiring urgent vascular assessment.
links.quote: Both LLMs demonstrated high proficiency in identifying the etiology of vascular lesions and recognizing critical "red flags," such as signs of ischemia requiring urgent vascular assessment.

links.outcome: Agreement of LLM wound management recommendations with expert consensus, including contraindications
links.effect: Perfect agreement in management recommendations was 75.0% for Gemini vs 60.0% for ChatGPT; both models wrongly suggested NPWT in a case potentially contraindicated by severe infection.
links.quote: Gemini achieved a slightly higher percentage of perfect agreement in management recommendations (75.0% vs. 60.0% for ChatGPT).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT and Gemini) on retrospective clinical wound images compared against expert clinician consensus, measuring diagnostic and management accuracy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
